tokens.title: Design tokens
tokens.intro: A living preview of the EDEN HOUSE theme. Every value here comes from a single file, src/styles/theme.css — change it and this page changes along with the whole store.
tokens.colorIntro: The semantic roles below are the only ones components should ever use.
tokens.typeIntro: Editorial serif for headings, neutral grotesque for the interface.
tokens.sampleBody: We design few pieces, and we keep them a long time. Each season adds one or two things to the wardrobe, never a whole collection.
